title: The Parisi formula
credit_lines: The SK proof in Lean is from Qiang Wu’s ParisiFormula project. The passage links, comparisons, notes and supplementary Lean checks are contributed by this project with AI assistance.
companion_credit: Paper by Michel Talagrand. Lean proof by Qiang Wu’s ParisiFormula project.
licence: Publisher PDF from the Annals of Mathematics, reproduced for educational and scientific use.
review: The upstream proof covers the exact-covariance SK model. The three files under Supplements contain separately checked reader contributions.

source.lean_scope: The upstream Lean follows Talagrand’s proof in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model with exact quadratic covariance. The paper’s general covariance hypotheses have wider scope.

topics.name: Spin overlap and covariance
topics.description: The off-diagonal Hamiltonian, the overlap and the covariance approximation in (1.3).

topics.name: Finite-level Parisi functional
topics.description: The masses and breakpoints, the Gaussian recursion, and the finite-level functional and its infimum.

topics.name: Limit of the free energy
topics.description: Theorem 1.1 and the passage from interpolation at a fixed time to the limit at time one.

topics.name: Guerra’s identity and upper bound
topics.description: The interpolating pressure, its one-sided derivative bound and the decoupled time-zero calculation.

topics.name: Convergence below time one
topics.description: Compactness and reduction of a minimizing scheme, the linear comparison, and integration of the pressure gap.

topics.name: Shared fields and constrained pressure
topics.description: The two-replica law, shared Gaussian fields, half masses and the pressure at a prescribed overlap.

topics.name: Probability of a prescribed overlap
topics.description: The pressure deficit bounds a single overlap probability, and summation over the overlap grid gives concentration.

topics.name: A second interpolation
topics.description: The fixed-overlap derivative estimate and the comparison with the endpoint at which the sites decouple.

topics.name: Gaussian averaging
topics.description: Variance differentiation, splitting the variance between two steps and interchanging steps.

topics.name: Variations at a minimizing scheme
topics.description: First variation in a mass, the endpoint stationarity identity and the curvature bound at a breakpoint.

topics.name: Quadratic penalty near a breakpoint
topics.description: The two constructions obtained by inserting the prescribed overlap on either side of the target breakpoint.

topics.name: Strict gap beyond neighboring breakpoints
topics.description: The interleaved interpolation and strict scalar comparison for overlaps away from the target breakpoint.

topics.name: Uniform quadratic overlap penalty
topics.description: Theorem 2.4 assembles the local quadratic estimate and the uniform deficit away from the target breakpoint.
